definition.note: Weber's singly periodic surface with two annular and two helicoidal ends -- the simpler surface with the same end types as Scherk's fourth surface, which the Scherk IV post says he found accidentally.

provenance.definition: Not transcribed. The record exists to state that the surface is absent and why; a fabricated equation would be worse than a null.
sources: M. Weber, 'The Half-Twisted Scherk Surface', minimalsurfaces.blog (local mirror: minsurf/book/.../ch152_the_half_twisted_scherk_surface.md).
